audit.why: Chart is consistent across both layers (Kled 1-4, Skill at 6, Kled first/two items) and matches the 57.53% win rate over 259 games. Left untouched so the mirror is not disturbed.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] framed level 6 as a clean Kled spike without the ultimate cooldown comparison. Fury of the Sands is 120/100/80; Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140/125/110.
audit.why: His ult out-cycles yours at every rank, so 'wait for his R' is not a repeatable plan across a long side lane — you get one commit per two of his.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now states 120s vs 140s and that his ult returns first.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer claims Fury of the Sands gives lifesteal ('R's lifesteal and size let him face-tank', 'R lifesteal out-sustains your trades'). It does not.
audit.why: Riot's R text lists bonus Health, Attack Range, nearby damage, reduced Siphoning Strike cooldown, bonus Armor and Magic Resistance — no healing. His lifesteal is the passive, Soul Eater. The mirror audit flagged the same false claim.
audit.corrected: late and wants.foe[2] rewritten to bonus health/resists, with Soul Eater named as the actual lifesteal source.
sources: champ-data/_kits/nasus.json (P Soul Eater, R Fury of the Sands)

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing stated that Bear Trap on a Rope only yanks and only deals its bonus physical damage if the leash survives its duration.
audit.why: That is the single mechanic the level 2-3 all-in hangs on: land Q then close so the tether cannot break, otherwise the Q was a slow and nothing more.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text rewritten to the leash rule and the follow-up E.
sources: champ-data/_kits/kled.json (Q: 'If shackled for a short duration, the target takes additional physical damage and is yanked toward Kled')

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere. Every Wither line said 'bait it' with no number attached.
audit.why: Wither is 15/14/13/12/11s. Naming the 15s at rank 1 turns 'bait it' into an actual window the player can count.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now gives the 15s figure and tells you to all-in inside it.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1].d ('Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown') did not match its own heading, 'Get dismounted and kited'.
audit.why: Boilerplate carried over from a template. The real reason dismounting is fatal here is that Wither removes your ability to disengage on foot.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to state the dismount damage loss plus Wither denying the walk-away.

edits.before: Survive to two items where stacked Q one-shots Skaarl and R lifesteal out-sustains your trades
edits.after: Survive to two items where stacked Q one-shots Skaarl and R's bonus health tanks your combo

edits.before: Your E-W-E re-E all-in plus Q's percent-max-HP damage shreds a low-stack Nasus before his Q ever gets going.
edits.after: Bear Trap only yanks if the leash survives, so E in behind it — then W's four shots chunk a low-stack Nasus.

edits.before: R lets you charge him out of W-wither range and extend the kill, turning every Q stack he wants into a death.
edits.after: Charge him out of Wither range to extend the kill — but Fury of the Sands is 120s to your 140s and returns first.

edits.before: His only kite. Bait it before committing. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Wither is 15s at rank 1 — bait it, then all-in inside that window before it returns.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Dismounted your damage drops and Wither means you cannot walk away.

edits.before: Be honest with yourself: if Nasus free-farmed to two items, this flips hard. His stacked Q one-shots Skaarl in a single auto, W-wither turns off your W shots and your re-E mobility, and R's lifesteal and size let him face-tank your whole combo. You do NOT win the late 1v1 — your frontloaded burst can't out-DPS infinite Q stacks. The plan is to have already ended: close the game on your first-item lead, group for objectives, and never let him into a side-lane scaling fest where his Q decides the fight.
edits.after: Be honest with yourself: if Nasus free-farmed to two items, this flips hard. His stacked Q one-shots Skaarl in a single auto, W-wither turns off your W shots and your re-E mobility, and Fury of the Sands hands him bonus health, armour and MR to face-tank the combo — the sustain is Soul Eater, not the ult. You do NOT win the late 1v1 — your burst can't out-DPS infinite Q stacks. The plan is to have already ended: close on your first-item lead, group for objectives, and never let him side-lane you where his Q decides it.
